person.title: Person
person.hiddenVia: You hide the paths through @{handle}: you stay acquainted and still see their posts.

friends.title: Acquaintances
friends.emptyTip: Connections start in person, with an invite, or with a request to someone you've come across here.

requests.title: Acquaintance requests
requests.incomingEmpty: No one is asking right now.

suggestions.title: People you may know
suggestions.mutual: {count, plural, one {# mutual acquaintance} other {# mutual acquaintances}}

blocks.title: Blocked people
blocks.help: Blocked people never see that you blocked them. Your posts and paths stop reaching them through you, and theirs stop reaching you.

confirm.unfriend: Remove @{handle} from your acquaintances? Who invited whom stays visible.
confirm.block: Block @{handle}? This also removes them from your acquaintances. They are not told.
confirm.hide_via: Hide the paths through @{handle}? You stay acquainted and still see their posts; people you reach only through them drop out of your feed. They are not told.

errors.friend_cap: You have reached 1,000 acquaintances and open requests. Cancel a request or remove someone first.
errors.self_not_allowed: You cannot do that to yourself.

upgrade.title: Become friends in person
upgrade.offer: Met @{handle} in person? Show them your code and let them hear the handshake sound to become friends.
upgrade.hint: Ask @{handle} to open Join on their phone, signed in, choose “Scan their code” and scan this code.
